info.title: CodeIgniter 4 BFF Starter
info.description: Stateless Backend-for-Frontend over a ci4-api-starter hub and one or more ci4-domain-starter apps.

get.description: Detailed diagnostic only: aggregates the hub probe, four SELECT-only read-database probes, and local disk/writable checks. Do not poll this endpoint as a liveness or readiness monitor on low-capacity hosting.
Lightweight availability check. Does not probe upstreams; safe to call as often as needed (excluded from rate-limit).
Returns 200 when the BFF can reach the upstream hub (`GET {hubUrl}/ping`). The BFF has no database, so readiness is a function of hub reachability only.
Returns alive + uptime regardless of upstream state. Use to detect a stuck process; not a substitute for readiness.
Same contract as `GET /health`, mounted under `/api/v1` for clients that only use the versioned transport.
Same contract as `GET /ping`, mounted under `/api/v1` for clients that only use the versioned transport.
Same contract as `GET /ready`, mounted under `/api/v1` for clients that only use the versioned transport.
Same contract as `GET /live`, mounted under `/api/v1` for clients that only use the versioned transport.
Returns the complete bounded CMS analytics payload in one request. The period is closed to the four periods supported by the CMS analytics contract and the pages/referrers limit is fixed server-side.
Options bundle for the create form: categories, techniques and languages. No item section.

503.description: Catalog collection item workspace source unavailable

get.description: Same options bundle as the create workspace, plus the collection item itself.

422.description: itemId is not a positive integer

503.description: Catalog collection item workspace source unavailable

get.description: Languages, collections and (if the caller holds the permission) categories/tags needed to render the entry-creation form.
Same as the create variant, scoped to one existing entry.

422.description: entryId is not a positive integer

get.description: Languages, pages and collections needed to render the page-creation form.
Same as the create variant, scoped to one existing page.

422.description: pageId is not a positive integer

get.description: Menu, items, languages, pages, entries and collections needed to render the menu editor. Pass `itemId` to also scope a single-item section.

422.description: menuId is not a positive integer

get.summary: CMS menu editor bootstrap (scoped to one item)
get.description: Same as the menu-level bootstrap, plus a `sections.item` entry for the given menu item.

200.description: Menu editor bootstrap sections including the item

422.description: menuId or itemId is not a positive integer

get.description: Identity/social settings and languages needed to render the site identity editor.
Wizard configuration and its derived block-type map, resolved via the CMS Domain's own compound `/cms/wizard/config` endpoint (one HTTP round trip, no second call for block types).

Complete editor projection for one CMS page: translations, blocks, block types, taxonomy and translation status in one read. Optional `instance_id` scopes the block-form-options section to one block instance.

422.description: pageId or instance_id is not a positive integer

get.description: Complete editor projection for one CMS entry: translations, blocks, block types, taxonomy and translation status in one read. Optional `instance_id` scopes the block-form-options section to one block instance.

422.description: entryId or instance_id is not a positive integer

get.summary: Admin dashboard with partial source degradation
get.description: Introspects the visitor token and combines Hub, CMS, Catalog and Event dashboard summaries plus independent CMS analytics and translation sections. Each source is reported as `ok` or `unavailable`; one failed source does not fail the complete response.

diagnostics.description: Observed timing of the same bounded source operations used to build the snapshot, plus the database time of each existing read projection and cheap local hosting disk/writable checks. It does not add database probes or upstream health requests.

get.description: Returns one bounded, permission-aware lookup bundle for an Admin Event form context. Context is closed to occurrence, ticket_type, ticket, booking, and event_reference.
Options bundle for the create form: event types and languages. No event section.
Same options bundle as the create workspace, plus the event itself.

422.description: eventId is not a positive integer

get.description: Combines the authenticated Hub usage list with the CMS registry. Rows are deduplicated by source, resource, resource id and role; the CMS block context is preferred. `complete` is false whenever either source is unavailable, so the result must not be used as proof that a file is safe to delete.

200.description: Usage rows and per-source completeness state

get.description: Role, the complete permission catalog and the ids currently assigned to the role, from the Hub's own IAM role workspace endpoint. The BFF only authenticates and normalizes the response; the Hub is the sole owner of this read model.

403.description: Missing IAM permission on the Hub

422.description: roleId is not a positive integer

503.description: Hub IAM role workspace source unavailable

get.description: Summary and timeseries for one period, from the Hub's own Metrics workspace endpoint. The BFF only authenticates and normalizes the response; the Hub is the sole owner of this read model.

403.description: Missing Metrics permission on the Hub

get.description: OpenAPI contracts for the Admin module read projections.

200.description: Bounded category, collection, language and parent projections

get.description: Combines `data.profile` (hub `/api/v1/users/{uid}`) with `data.permissions.scope` (token claim) into a single response. The aggregator demonstrates the introspect-auth + fan-out pattern; replace the closures with the calls your dashboard actually needs.
Bounded, paginated, filterable listing of museum collection items.

422.description: Invalid locale, pagination, sort or fields

get.description: One item by numeric id or slug, including the complete localized slugs map, translations, category and techniques.
Main, footer and legal menus for the given locale, with resolved destination URLs and clickability.
Identity/social settings marked public, with resolved media URLs.
Locale-agnostic list of active languages with default/fallback flags.
Bounded, paginated list of published CMS pages for the locale.
Resolves one published CMS page by its full slug path (may contain slashes for nested pages). Supports a signed `preview` query for unpublished content.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Page slug path; may contain additional slash-separated segments

404.description: Page not found or unpublished without a valid preview signature

get.description: Resolves the singleton CMS page for a given `page_type` (e.g. `template_catalog_item`, `template_event_item`) instead of by slug — used to render Catalog/Event detail pages through CMS-owned templates.

404.description: No page of that type is published

get.description: Bounded, locale-scoped projection of pages, collections and entries for building a public sitemap.
Active, locale-scoped list of CMS collections (e.g. `noticias`, `teatroescuela`).

Bounded, paginated, filterable/orderable listing of published entries within one collection. `order_by`/`filter_by` accept a fixed set of entry columns or a facet field key (`entry.<column>`, `block.<key>.<field>`, or a bare facet key).

422.description: Invalid locale, pagination, order_by or filter_by shape

get.description: One published entry by slug, including the complete localized slugs map, taxonomy, blocks and related entries. Supports a signed `preview` query for unpublished content.

404.description: Entry not found or unpublished without a valid preview signature

get.description: `path` may contain additional slash-separated segments.

404.description: No redirect configured for this path

get.description: Bounded, paginated listing of public events/occurrences. `sort=agenda` (the default) orders upcoming occurrences first, then past ones descending.

422.description: Invalid locale, pagination, date range or sort

get.description: One event by numeric id or slug, including the complete localized slugs map, translations, occurrences and venues.

Resolves a redirect, CMS page, collection entry or collection fallback index for the given route, composed with layout (menus, settings) and block context. `route` may contain additional slash-separated segments. HTTP status mirrors the outcome: 200 for a resolved page, 301/302 for a redirect, 404 for not_found.

parameters.name: route
parameters.description: Route path; may contain additional slash-separated segments

200.description: Resolved page: routing outcome, layout and block context in one envelope

404.description: No page, redirect or entry resolves this route (outcome: not_found)

503.description: A required read source is unavailable

get.description: Forwards `GET /api/v1/users/{id}` to the hub and returns the upstream response unchanged. Authentication is forward-only — the BFF relays the bearer token without decoding it.

AuthToken.title: Authentication Token
AuthToken.description: JWT token with associated user data

UnauthorizedResponse.description: Unauthorized - Invalid or missing authentication token

ValidationErrorResponse.description: Validation Error - Request data failed validation

bearerAuth.description: JWT issued by the upstream hub. The BFF forwards it verbatim on every call.

appKeyAuth.description: Shared application key for the unauthenticated public-read surface (`BFF_API_KEY`/`WEB_API_KEY`). Distinct from `hub.apiKey`, which identifies the BFF for its own outbound Hub calls.
appKeyAuth.name: X-App-Key
